title: The Queue Stills
heading: Stills, round 1
intro: A counter hall where every window says POWER, built from Unsplash layouts. Portraits first, then the story in order, ending on the phone screen the logo goes onto. I've picked one per row; overrule or note any. Pollution check: clean (only this short's own wording and the brand's mask line repeat).
